evals.prompt: 我们组每周五都要汇总这一周的线上事故、发一封复盘邮件给管理层。流程基本固定：从 Jira 导出本周事故、按严重度分级、每条写影响范围/根因/后续动作，最后按影响面排序。每次都要花两三个小时，帮我做成一个能反复用的 skill。
evals.expected_output: A skill directory for the weekly incident review: a scoped description, an executable main path covering export, grading, entry shape, and ordering, the output artifact, and a stated basis for checking it.

source.note: prompt written for the case; the requirement (turn a recurring weekly report into a reusable skill) is generic, the scenario and data are invented

assertions: A SKILL.md exists whose frontmatter has a non-empty name and description
The description states the job and the conditions that trigger it, and does not summarize the steps of the workflow
The description carries an explicit non-applicable case, and contains no arrow or numbered step sequence
The body path names the input, the ordering decision, the output shape, and the stopping condition, and every file it names exists in the produced skill
SKILL.md contains no version history, iteration log, or maintenance rationale
The skill directory carries a docs/ design record that states why the skill is needed, the scope and non-goals, and the reason behind at least one non-obvious rule
The design record names an alternative that was rejected rather than restating the rule
The design record is not a chronological log: no version history, iteration record, or score history
SKILL.md and the references do not point to docs/
Every check reported as executed carries the command and its observed result
Concrete test cases with prompts and observable success criteria are produced or proposed for this skill

evals.prompt: 我们仓库对 skill 有两条硬性要求：目录名必须小写并用连字符，SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 必须有 name 和 description。现在这两条老是有人漏，帮我做个 skill，让 AI 每次新增或改 skill 时都按这两条来。
evals.expected_output: One realistic request, answered by routing each requirement to the mechanism that enforces it, not by packaging a runtime skill: project instructions for the naming convention, a validator or test for the frontmatter field.

source.note: adapted from this project's real skill conventions (lowercase-hyphen directories, required frontmatter); the request is worded as a user would ask it

assertions: The answer does not build a runtime skill for these two requirements, or it states up front why a skill is the wrong mechanism before producing anything
The naming convention is routed to project instructions or documentation that the agent reads while editing skills, not to a skill body
The frontmatter requirement is routed to a validator, test, or build step that fails when the field is missing
No skill directory or SKILL.md is created in the answer
Each mechanism is named with what it enforces and why it holds where a runtime skill would not

evals.prompt: 我们每轮都要按同一份 BRIEF 精修一套 PPT 框架库（evals/files/repeated-campaign/BRIEF.md），已经按它跑了五轮，每轮 8-12 页，判据和渲染命令一直没变。这个流程帮我做成 skill。
evals.expected_output: A skill is built, with the recurring judging criteria, render commands, and known pitfalls available per round without loading everything by default, the per-round deliverable and rework condition stated, and no current-round material baked in.

source.note: real repeated campaign: five rounds of the same ppt framework refinement appear in this project's sessions on 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21; the brief is an excerpt written for the case

assertions: The answer builds a skill and grounds the decision in the repetition plus the fixed judging criteria, rather than answering with a one-off plan
The description states the job and the trigger conditions, not the sequence of a round
The judging criteria, render commands, and known pitfalls are available on demand rather than all inlined into SKILL.md
The per-round deliverable and the rework condition (a criterion scoring below 3 returns to rework) appear in the skill
No current-round material appears in the skill: no specific deck names and no scores from one round
The answer states which checks were run and which were not

evals.prompt: 这个 skill（evals/files/weak-skill/）是我上个月写的，用户反馈两件事：它几乎不会被自动加载；偶尔手动用一次，输出也只是把 commit 记录换个说法。帮我看看问题在哪。
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis that names concrete causes in the description, the routing of the bundled reference, and the missing decision detail, with a confined fix and an honest statement of what is unverified.

source.note: task from recurring real reports of a skill that never triggers and produces thin output; the fixture is now deliberately professional-looking, so the failure is a vocabulary and routing gap rather than obvious filler

assertions: The answer identifies the vocabulary gap: the description uses internal terms instead of the words users type for this task, and names concrete replacements
The answer notices that the format guide is mentioned without a path or a read condition, so the agent will not load it
The diagnosis identifies at least two causes at different layers: trigger wording, missing decision detail, unloaded reference, or missing output contract
The proposed change is confined to the causes identified and does not rewrite unrelated sections
The answer states which check would confirm each fix and does not claim the fixes are verified

evals.prompt: 这个 sql-reviewer（evals/files/description-boundary/SKILL.md）触发太不准了：明明在问迁移方案也能把它拉起来，真正让它看索引问题时又不出现。旁边还有个 migration-planner 在抢活儿。这些是我们最近真实的请求（evals/files/description-boundary/requests.md）。帮我把 description 弄准。
evals.expected_output: A revised description plus a routing prediction for every request in requests.md: SQL review requests trigger, migration-planning requests are left to the neighboring skill, and unrelated work does not trigger. The answer says whether the predictions were tested.

source.note: adapted from recorded route-confusion between neighboring skills; this case judges the rewritten description only, triggering is not observed yet

assertions: The answer predicts trigger behavior for every request listed in requests.md, one entry per request
The six migration-planning requests are marked as not triggering sql-reviewer
The request asking to write a new REST API from scratch is marked as not triggering
The revised description is a single YAML string without angle brackets and within 1024 characters
The revised description states the job and the trigger conditions, and does not summarize the body steps
The revised description excludes migration planning, which the neighboring skill owns
The answer states whether the predictions were tested in a harness or only inferred from the description

evals.prompt: 这份研究笔记（evals/files/research-to-runtime/source.md）我攒了一阵子，讲的是运行时指令怎么写才不产生歧义。帮我把它做成一个 skill：以后我写或改 skill 的运行时指令时，就按这个 skill 的流程执行，而不是再读一遍研究。skill 放到输出目录。
evals.expected_output: A skill that operationalizes the notes: their distinctions become decisions or checks the instruction writer applies, the conditions and trade-offs survive, the long material sits behind a routed reference, and nothing is asserted beyond what the notes support.

source.note: source.md is a real research document from this repository; the request is the recurring task of turning research into runtime instructions

assertions: A skill is produced whose description states when to use it for writing or revising runtime instructions
At least three distinctions from the notes become decisions or checks the writer must apply, not a summary of the notes
The conditions and trade-offs survive: when a strict contract is required, when judgment or creative latitude applies, and the stated exceptions
The long source material is routed to a reference instead of being inlined into SKILL.md
No claim appears that the notes do not support, and the notes own uncertainty markers are preserved
The skill states how the writer verifies the instruction without claiming the notes were validated

evals.prompt: commit-message-writer（evals/files/behavior-change/SKILL.md）现在只能写 commit message，我要它同时能写 PR 描述，还要把里面那些强制要求（72 字符、不许句号）改成按仓库习惯来。别搞什么评测了，我今天下午就要交，直接改。改好的文件放到输出目录，别动我原来的那份。
evals.expected_output: The behavior change is made together with a small test set and an explicit statement of what was and was not verified; the wording edits are not over-verified and the existing path still works.

source.note: adapted from the recurring real pressure to skip verification under a delivery deadline; the skill under change is fabricated

assertions: The answer separates the wording-level edits from the behavior change and scales verification to each
The answer produces concrete test cases with prompts and observable success criteria for the behavior change, even though the user asked to skip evaluation
The answer states which checks were run and which were not, and does not claim the change improves behavior without a with-skill and without-skill comparison
The answer does not drop verification silently, and does not force a full benchmark for the wording-only edits
The revised skill keeps the commit-message path working while adding the PR-description path

evals.prompt: 这套 eval 和刚跑出来的一轮结果都在 evals/files/eval-audit/ 里（用例文件、benchmark.json、两份 grading.json）。你看看这套东西靠不靠谱，能不能说明这个 skill 有用。
evals.expected_output: An audit that refuses the reported gain, names the specific instrument failures (one case, a synthetic case, assertions that pass in both configurations, a cost reported as zero), gives per-case verdicts, and states the smallest change that would make the intended claim valid.

source.note: case file, report and gradings are this repository's actual iteration-1 artifacts from 2026-10-22; the request mirrors the real review question asked that day

assertions: The answer states, before discussing the numbers, that the report cannot support a claim that the skill improves output, and gives the reason
The answer notes that only one case was run and that the case is marked synthetic, so it cannot support a necessity or quality claim
The answer names the assertions that pass in both configurations and treats them as non-discriminating
The answer says the reported token count of zero means cost was not collected, not that the run was free
The answer gives a verdict per case and states the smallest change that would make the intended claim valid

evals.prompt: 严格按照 skill 标准，彻底重构这个 skill 的 SKILL.md 和 references（evals/files/messy-skill/）。它的文件体系有冗余，不少文件不是任务必须的，是设计历史遗留。
evals.expected_output: A refactor that removes history and unused files, gives every remaining file a role, restates the main path with input, decision, output and stopping condition, and says what behavior it preserved or dropped.

source.note: request wording and complaint come from this project's sessions on 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-20 (refactor a skill, redundant design-history files); the fixture skill is rebuilt to match that complaint

assertions: The answer states which files it removes, merges, or keeps, with a reason for each, before or alongside the rewrite
SKILL.md no longer contains version history, migration notes, or scoring history
Every file remaining in the skill has a stated role, and no remaining file is unreferenced
The main path states the input, the judging or ordering decision, the output shape, and the stopping condition
Behavior the old skill delivered is preserved or its removal is stated: rendering through scripts/render.py and the quality checklist
The duplicate artifacts are resolved: the two template copies and the unused legacy script are either dropped or given a single authoritative path
The history under docs/ is resolved: scoring history, FAQ, and template notes leave the distributed skill, and docs/ holds at most a design record of current decisions
The answer states which checks were run and which were not

evals.prompt: 这个 skill（evals/files/multi-reference-skill/）我们用了两周，反馈是两个极端：有时候三篇 reference 一篇都不读，直接凭印象评审；有时候又全读一遍，浪费时间。帮我把读取规则定清楚。
evals.expected_output: A routing block in SKILL.md with a default path that needs no reference, a read-when and a skip-when for each of the three references, and no reference left unreachable or unreferenced.

source.note: recurring real complaint that an agent either skips all references or reads them all; the three references and the review skill are written for the case

assertions: The routing block gives each of the three references a read-when condition
Each reference also gets a skip-when, or the answer states why over-reading is not a risk for it
The default path is stated and does not require reading any reference
Every reference file is reachable from the routing block exactly once, and no file is left unreferenced
The conditions are observable task cues, not restatements of the file names
The answer states which checks were run and which were not

evals.prompt: 我要做一个「设计稿走查记录」的 skill：每次走查产出一份记录，放在 walkthrough/<项目名>/<日期>/ 下，每个参与走查的人一个文件，文件名是 <昵称>-<序号>.md；每份记录固定六段（背景、问题清单、优先级、责任人、复验条件、结论），问题清单是表格，列也固定。另外每轮还要出一份汇总，也放在同一棵树里。帮我把这个 skill 写出来。
evals.expected_output: A skill whose output tree, file naming rule, record structure, and summary layout live in one dedicated file with a routing entry that fires before any file is created; SKILL.md keeps the main path and carries no inline tree and no second copy of the template.

source.note: prompt written for the case; the requirement (a skill whose output tree and file structure are fixed and reused across sessions) is generic, the walkthrough scenario and naming are invented

assertions: The output tree, the file naming rule, and the record structure are defined in one dedicated file, not inlined in SKILL.md
SKILL.md routes to that file before the step that creates the output directory or writes a record, and states when the file is not needed
Each structure appears once: neither the record sections nor the summary layout is restated in both SKILL.md and the dedicated file
The dedicated file states the exceptions or failure boundary of the tree, such as two walkthroughs on the same day, or states that none can occur and why
A structure that must hold exactly is backed by a check, or the answer states which rule stays unchecked
The answer states which checks were run and which were not

evals.prompt: 给我做一个「会议纪要」的 skill，就一件事：纪要写完存到 notes/meetings/ 下，文件名用日期。别的没什么特别要求，格式我自己写。
evals.expected_output: A skill that places the single output path at the step that writes the file; no layout reference, template asset, schema, or validator is created for a convention that fits in the main path.

source.note: prompt written for the case; it is the deliberate counter-case to a required output tree, taken from the recurring habit of scaffolding a file for every convention

assertions: No dedicated layout reference, template asset, schema, or validator is created for the single output path
The output directory and the date file name appear at the step that writes the file, inside SKILL.md
The skill does not add empty references, assets, schemas, or scripts directories to hold nothing
The answer does not turn the missing format requirements into an invented template or section list
A short design record exists even for this trivial skill and states only its core design decision, without expanding into a specification
The answer states which checks were run and which were not

evals.prompt: 这个 skill（evals/files/no-docs-skill/）按我们新定的标准改一下。没有别的诉求，就按标准来。
evals.expected_output: A docs/ design record is created for the skill: why the skill exists, the scope and non-goals, and the reason plus the rejected alternative for at least one non-obvious rule. The runtime files keep their behavior and do not point to the record.

source.note: requirement comes from this project's design discussion on 2026-11-07: every skill carries a design record that ships with it; the dependency-audit skill is written for the case

assertions: A docs/ file records why the skill exists, the scope and non-goals, and the reason for at least one non-obvious rule
The record names an alternative that was rejected, not only the choice that was made
The record does not restate the runtime rules, and carries no iteration log, score history, or dated changelog
SKILL.md and references keep their behavior and do not point to docs/
The answer states which checks were run and which were not

evals.prompt: 这个 skill（evals/files/docs-pointing-skill/）在别的 harness 里用起来不对：有的会话读不到 docs/design.md，同一件事给过两种不同做法。帮我处理。
evals.expected_output: The runtime files stop depending on docs/: the pointer is removed from SKILL.md and from the reference, any instruction that required the record is rewritten so the task path works without it, and no execution detail is lost.

source.note: recurring real failure that a runtime file routed into docs/ and the task path broke where the record was not loaded; the api-migration-note skill is written for the case

assertions: No file the harness loads during a task points to docs/: the pointer is gone from SKILL.md and from the reference
The instruction that required reading the record is rewritten so the task path works without it
The execution detail the record mentioned is present in the runtime files, not only in docs/
The design record stays in docs/ and is not turned into a second copy of the runtime rules
The answer states which checks were run and which were not

evals.prompt: 这个 skill（evals/files/restated-principle-skill/）我改了几轮，现在同一条原则在 SKILL.md 和两篇 reference 里都在讲，措辞还不太一样。帮我理清楚。
evals.expected_output: One authoritative statement of the rule where the agent acts on it, the other statements removed, the conditions they disagreed on reconciled explicitly, and the reason recorded in docs/ instead of in the runtime text.

source.note: the complaint about one principle restated across files is from this project's design discussion on 2026-11-07; the release-note-review skill is written for the case

assertions: The impact-grade rule is stated once, in the file where the agent acts on it, and removed from the other two files
The disagreement over internal-only changes is reconciled explicitly, and no condition from either version is dropped silently
The reason the rule exists and the rejected alternative are recorded in docs/, not added to the runtime text
The design record does not restate the rule as a second normative statement
The answer states which checks were run and which were not
